summary: GATE-EX6 closes as pass_with_conditions for validator/dry-run CLI implementation only. It accepts the EX-6 schemas and validator/CLI implementation plan as adequate for a later bounded implementation sprint while preserving all candidate-storage, candidate-write, q19 extraction execution, protected mutation, lesson-output, CP-6/Year-1 closure, and student/product-use blocks.

explicit_decisions.decision: Close GATE-EX6 as pass_with_conditions - validator/dry-run CLI implementation only.
Accept the three-schema split for operation candidates, answer-skill candidates, and source-annex extraction overlays.
Accept the operation-candidate schema for validator implementation, with a condition to distinguish weak and rejected unit evidence before persistent candidate writes.
Accept the answer-skill schema as sufficient to keep q3 threshold wording and q15 two-step correction-model explanation visible.
Accept the q19 extraction schema for validator implementation, with conditional validation requiring substantive graph/source detail before reconstructable states.
Accept rejection rules and add rules for empty/vague q19 reconstructability fields and ambiguous weak/rejected unit evidence.
Accept the dry-run CLI contract; any future write branch must hard-fail without a later closed gate naming the exact write lane.
Require non-persistent, test-only dry-run fixtures; do not commit realistic candidate records inside references/data/exam-ingestion/ as fixtures.
Authorize EX-7 Validator And Dry-Run CLI Implementation only, with no candidate-storage creation, no candidate writes, and no q19 extraction execution.

No protected reference mutation, external-source mutation, machine-reference mutation, unit minting, operation-registry mutation, answer-skill mutation, candidate writes, q19 extraction execution, PV/graph mutation, lesson-output mutation, CP-6 closure, Year-1 closure, diagnostics, adaptive routing, mastery, sequencing, student-facing AI, summative use, PV projection, PV machine promotion, or student-facing output is authorized.

accepted_outcomes: GATE-EX6 may close as a planning review gate.
The three-schema split is accepted for later validator implementation.
The validator/CLI implementation plan is adequate for a bounded implementation sprint.
The next sprint may implement validators and dry-run CLIs only.
Dry-run fixtures may be used only as non-persistent, test-only artifacts.
GATE-EX5 routing facts remain binding: q3 A61 support with A15 rejected; q19 A42/D10 support with A45 weak; q19 gaps blocking; q3/q15 answer-skill needs visible.
blocked_outcomes: No q19 source-annex extraction execution is authorized.
No q19 graph-object extraction execution is authorized.
No protected reference mutation is authorized.
No student diagnostics, adaptive routing, mastery decisions, automatic sequencing, student-facing AI, summative use, PV projection, PV machine promotion, or student-facing output is authorized.
conditions_to_reopen_or_pass: The next sprint must not create operation-candidates.json, answer-skill-candidates.json, or source-annex-extraction-overlays.json.
The next sprint must not write candidate records.
The next sprint must not execute q19 source-annex or graph-object extraction.
Weak and rejected unit evidence must be distinguished before any persistent candidate write.
Validators must reject reconstructable q19 extraction states with empty or vague required graph/source detail fields.
Dry-run CLIs must not expose usable write mode under EX-6 authority.
A15 cannot be q3 annual-threshold support.
A45 cannot be primary q19 graph-shift support.
q3 threshold wording and q15 two-step correction-model explanation must remain visible as answer-skill needs.
